items.title: THE GLIDING MAN
cards: Every firewatch tower in Lummox County keeps a ranger's logbook.
Read them and the notes turn strange: 'See the gliding man', then a drawing of him.
Nobody knows who he is yet.

items.title: DINOSAUR FOOTPRINTS
cards: Under the railway bridge north-east of Grayson, on the rock by the river.
At night. Shine a torch on the slab.
Follow the footprints across the stone.

items.title: THE LEVIATHAN
cards: On the seabed off Mariana County. Grab a diving suit.
A giant sea monster skeleton: rows of teeth and a ribcage you can swim through.
Nothing in the game says what it was.

items.title: THE CAPRI CAGE
cards: Capri. Mouth off to two cops as Lucia.
They don't take her to jail. They lock her in a cage at their compound, next to a man painted gold.
'You're not allowed to speak. You're a statue.'

items.title: IN THE TALL GRASS
cards: The cane fields north of Belville.
At night. A kid's voice calls you into the tall grass.
It says you're going the wrong way, then begs you not to look and not to move.

items.title: MOUNT CHILIAD IS BACK
cards: A photo in the President's secret bunker.
President Russo on Mount Chiliad in 1962, shaking hands with an alien.
Mount Chiliad was GTA 5's UFO mountain.
